title: Hard reset on G6 breaks transmitter
symptom: After a hard reset on a Dexcom G6 transmitter, xDrip lost contact with the transmitter entirely, and the Dexcom app could not find it either, making it appear trashed.
cause: The condition where you would get that message implies the transmitter has already failed.
evidence_quote: The condition where you would get that message implies the transmitter has already failed.
